title: Voice and tone
slide_intent: Address readers as people with different needs and contexts. A recognizable voice can vary its tone according to the message and audience.
strategic_value: Slack can sound familiar in multiple situations while preserving the precision that work communication needs.
demonstration: The left statement describes speaking directly to a user. The right column explains a more human voice and the need to vary tone by audience, context and information.
practical_value: Decide how conversational to be by identifying the audience, situation and information the reader needs.
